assignment.title: Cleaning a survey dataset
assignment.instructions:
Clean the practice student-survey dataset and hand in a short write-up of what you did. Your write-up must:
- list the columns you dropped and why
- explain how you handled missing ages
- explain how you removed duplicate responses
- confirm that your notebook runs end to end
- give a before-and-after row count

sections.heading: Dropped columns
paragraphs: I dropped four columns. The first was respondent_email, because it identifies people and the analysis does not need it. The second was ip_address, for the same reason. The third was free_comment_2, which was empty for almost every respondent. The fourth was survey_version, because it had the same value in every response, so it carries no information.

sections.heading: Missing ages
paragraphs: Rows with a missing age were dropped.

sections.heading: Duplicates
paragraphs: Some students submitted the survey twice. I treated two responses as duplicates when they had the same hashed student identifier and the same answers to all the rating questions. When that happened I kept the earlier submission by timestamp and removed the later one. Responses from the same student with different answers were kept, because a changed answer is not a duplicate.

sections.heading: Notebook
paragraphs: All the cleaning steps are in the notebook cleaning.ipynb, in the order described above, and it is meant to be run from the first cell to the last.
